verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no way to filter or gate findings by severity or confidence. The only noise controls documented are baselines, which ignore old findings, and per-rule allowlists, which suppress matches. Both are adjacent false-positive suppression features, not severity- or confidence-based thresholds for failing builds.

support.subject: As a developer, I can filter and gate on findings by severity or confidence so low-value noise does not block builds

citations.quote: You can define multiple allowlists for a rule to reduce false positives.
When using a baseline, gitleaks will ignore any old findings that are present in the baseline.
